th.style: background:#f1f3f5; border-bottom:1.5px solid #333333; padding:10px 14px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#111827; text-align:left;

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

td.b: UC-01: Submit Application for Automated Deployment

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;
width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. Developer is authenticated via Google OAuth.
2. Valid Python source file (.py) or ZIP archive (.zip) within allowed size limit.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. Developer opens dashboard, selects application, and submits source bundle.
2. Platform validates payload, extracts files safely, and isolates source directory.
3. System creates a new version record with status analysing and increments version number.
4. System spawns detached build worker; dashboard transitions to polling status and logs.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
Success: Version record registered, bundle isolated, and asynchronous analysis initiated.
Failure: Bundle discarded, error message displayed, and no version created.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
3a. Unsupported archive / unsafe path: Upload rejected with validation error.
4a. Database or storage failure: System returns 503 error; developer prompted to retry.
